notes: IndustrialPlanner is treated as a viewer/editor target, not as a certified proof sink.
The current exporter is one-way and may be lossy for generic facilities, dual-layer routing, and exact-only metadata.

canonical export timestamp is preserved in the target blueprint root

lossy_mappings.reason: generic canonical facility templates are approximated through representative IndustrialPlanner device ids
liquid-like routing is inferred heuristically from commodity names; junction coverage is partial
elevated bridge cells are collapsed into planar target devices

dropped_fields.reason: protocol_core instances are omitted and represented indirectly through blueprint.baseId
viewer/editor target does not carry exact-proof iteration metadata
viewer/editor target has no certified solve-time field

derived_mappings.reason: target blueprint baseId is chosen from exporter options instead of a canonical facility record
